title: Puka Nacua: We have to look in the mirror and say what our identity will be

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Puka Nacua: We have to look in the mirror and say what our identity will be
sources.description: The Rams produced a lot of eye-popping numbers on Monday night, including a career-high 17 catches for wide receiver Puka Nacua, but the most important ones weren't positive ones for the team.
